limits: Saved policy values are not proof of continuous kernel enforcement.
Sampling and cold boot can change race timing. Absence of marked DNS in a new sample does not invalidate earlier captures.
DNS without markers and endpoint-only SYNs have no UID attribution.
No physical, gateway, IPv6 uplink, cellular, LMK, pre-unlock or overnight scope was exercised.
Source snapshots were reconstructed from HEAD and known edit ordering after the runs; raw logs and captures are original.
